proved: The exact plan-authenticated executable contains RSQRTSS at0x47f953 in HWWall::SetupLights, followed by scalar Newton-refinement instructions.
HWSeg::Normal computes float1/sqrtf(length_squared); hw_walls.cpp is compiled with the repository fast-math policy.
The GetRightUp path instead calls the bundled c_sqrt at0x47fe1e and0x47ff17.
HWWall::SetupLights calls GetLight at0x4801c2 and increments draw_dlight from its acceptance result at0x4801d3.
VkRenderState::UploadLights accounts and uploads actual accepted normal-light records, so the differing counters describe real per-frame submitted data.
Retained authored map includes walls at y=384 and y=-384, and authenticated live-light records include radius192 lights at y=192 and y=-192.

retained_runtime_disassembly.conclusion: Hardwired approximate reciprocal-square-root plus strict light-boundary tests is a concrete plausible mechanism, not a causal reconstruction of the observed59-record difference. Renderer and comparison policy remain unchanged.
